title: Positive-degree part of the signed scalar cup resolution comparison
statement: For a field k, a scheme X over Spec k, modules F and G and a cup resolution pairing D [def-sc-module-cup-resolution-data], let a,b,c be global resolution cycles in degrees p,q,p+q and assume p>0, q>0 and c.val=D.pair p q top a.val b.val. The scalar cup [def-sc-field-linear-module-cohomology-operations] of their left and right classes equals (-1)^(p*q) times the class of c.

proof.text: Pairing with a fixed right cycle b defines O-linear sheaf morphisms pairRightComponent from the degree-n left term to the degree-(n+q) target term. Naturality follows from D.restriction, and closedness of b with Leibniz proves pairRightComponent_comm. These maps assemble into the actual map pairRightMap to the q-th tail using Mathlib's HomologicalComplex.d_comp_eqToHom for differential transport, without a duplicate helper theorem. Multiplying degree n by (-1)^(n*q) and extending by zero gives pairRightCochain. Its differential vanishes by pairRightCochain_closed: cancel the two terms using the tail-map chain equation and (-1)^(q+1)*(-1)^((n+1)*q)=-(-1)^(n*q). Negative source degrees vanish. All these private constructions and proofs are complete.

Transport a resolution cycle through D.comparison and apply homology-pi naturality. The defining injective-cocycle formula for moduleExtEquiv identifies D.class with InjectiveResolution.extMk. Exact scalar restriction and precomposition with scalarUnitMorphism give the formula for scalarCohomologyExtEquiv. The private class_ext_formula and scalar_class_ext_formula prove these formulas in every degree.

Remaining comparison: after exact scalar restriction, identify the localized pairRightCochain over the left augmentation with tensor transport of the right Ext class followed by scalarTensorCoefficient. For this identification, D.pair in bidegrees (0,n), with the left input in the augmentation, defines a map from scalar F tensor the right resolution to the target resolution. Leibniz gives its chain equation, augmentation_pair identifies its coefficient map, and exact tensoring by a sheaf of k-vector spaces inverts the tensor augmentation. The localized comparison from the preceding step identifies the fixed right cycle with its Ext class. Composing with the left class evaluates the degree-p component of pairRightCochain, hence gives (-1)^(p*q) times the paired target cycle. Target comparison and additivity of scalarCohomologyExtEquiv give the equality. The alternative total-tensor proof in the docstring gives the same normalization by Mathlib shift interchange. The constructions cover characteristic two, zero cycles and empty schemes. Both zero-degree axes are already proved in the parent.

from.place: The sole proof step invokes lem-sc-general-theorem-of-cube. Its special-fibre Picard argument (Tag 0BF3) uses the Varieties Tag 0BED Kunneth external cup comparison. This is the signed positive-bidegree resolution calculation, after both zero-degree axes have been proved.

lean.statement:
theorem scalarCup_positive_resolution_class_compatibility
    {k : Type w} [Field k] {X : Scheme.{w}}
    (f : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) (F G : X.Modules) (p q : ℕ) (hp : 0 < p) (hq : 0 < q)
    (D : CupResolutionPairing F G)
    (a : ((((RingedSpace.globalSectionsFunctor X.toRingedSpace).mapHomologicalComplex
      (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).obj D.left.K).sc p).moduleCatLeftHomologyData.K)
    (b : ((((RingedSpace.globalSectionsFunctor X.toRingedSpace).mapHomologicalComplex
      (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).obj D.right.K).sc q).moduleCatLeftHomologyData.K)
    (c : ((((RingedSpace.globalSectionsFunctor X.toRingedSpace).mapHomologicalComplex
      (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).obj D.target.K).sc (p + q)).moduleCatLeftHomologyData.K)
    (hc : c.val = D.pair p q ⊤ a.val b.val) :
    scalarCohomologyCup f F G p q (D.left.class p a) (D.right.class q b) =
      (-1 : ℤ) ^ (p * q) • D.target.class (p + q) c
